quarters not derived (the year-to-date fact's tag has no shorter leg in the same tag: the 10-Qs carried the figure in another caption; flagged basis_break_quarterly): deferred_taxes 2020-12-31, deferred_taxes 2021-12-31, deferred_taxes 2022-12-31, deferred_taxes 2023-12-31, deferred_taxes 2024-09-30, deferred_taxes 2025-09-30, other_noncash 2023-12-31, other_noncash 2024-12-31, other_noncash 2025-12-31, change_receivables 2020-06-30, change_payables 2020-06-30, change_deferred_revenue 2020-06-30...

restricted cash: in 3 period(s), 2020-06-30..2021-03-31 the cash line is the filed cash + restricted cash total (CashCashEquivalentsRestrictedCashAndRestrictedCashEquivalents, the cash-flow statement's total, read where the annual report filed no CashAndCashEquivalentsAtCarryingValue for the date); in 3 period(s), 2020-06-30..2021-03-31 no figure separates the restricted part, so where those metrics are computed they still count restricted cash as cash (net cash overstated, net debt understated by the restricted amount; flagged incl_restricted_* and labelled 'some periods incl. restricted cash' on the metric; growth across a change between the two bases is blank)

basis break (four quarters vs the fiscal year, >1% apart — the quarters and the year were filed on different bases: restatement, reclassification or discontinued operations; those quarters carry basis_break_quarterly and the growth cells across them are blank): other_nonoperating: 2021-12-31 (49,000 vs 30,000); net_income: 2021-12-31 (-46,839,000 vs -60,135,000)

restricted cash: 6 growth cell(s) are blank because one of the two periods deducts restricted cash and the other still counts it as cash (no figure separates it there; flagged incl_restricted_*): net_cash (quarters 2021-06-30, 2021-09-30, 2022-03-31); net_cash_per_share (quarters 2021-06-30, 2021-09-30, 2022-03-31)
